messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Paging: elevated error-rate and timeouts for tenant=zelena on dedicated-pool-7. Incident ID INC-2026-0456. Paging oncall.
sam (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Seeing a spike in 5xxs and latency. Anyone already looking at pool-7?
kai (eng-runtime): I am. Queue depth for pool-7 is spiking, batch sizes exploded. Looks like scheduler is grouping very long sequences -> batches hitting memory/latency floor.
maya (custeng): Zelena reports intermittent timeouts from their web frontend, started ~09:02 PDT. Are they still fully routed to dedicated pool-7 (VPC)?
sam (oncall-sre): Yes, confirmed dedicated VPC. Impact: ~8-12% error rate on production traffic, affecting two customer endpoints.
kai (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: tenant scheduler knob max_batch_tokens currently 4096; request seq-length distribution lately is much larger -> oversized batches causing queuing and OOMs on some workers. Quick mitigation: lower max_batch_tokens and reduce per-tenant batch weight.
sam (oncall-sre): Can we flip that live without restarting workers?
kai (eng-runtime): Yes. Using rwtctl to apply a live tenant config patch. Pushing suggested change: scheduler.max_batch_tokens=1024, batcher.max_total_tokens_per_batch=49152, and set tenant queue_shaper=enabled with weight=0.6. Will apply one change at a time and watch.

kai (eng-runtime): Applying change now:
```
# apply live
rwtctl tenant update --tenant zelena --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=1024 --apply-live
rwtctl tenant update --tenant zelena --set batcher.max_total_tokens_per_batch=49152 --apply-live
rwtctl tenant update --tenant zelena --set queue_shaper.enabled=true --set queue_shaper.weight=0.6 --apply-live
```

incident-bot: Config change submitted by kai at 1764502475 (audit id a-cc-3344).
sam (oncall-sre): seeing immediate diff on metrics: p50 latency drop ~220ms -> 140ms, p95 down ~1.8s -> 950ms. Errors dropping but p99 still elevated.
kai (eng-runtime): PromQLs:
```
sum(rate(request_errors_total{tenant="zelena"}[1m])) by (code)
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant="zelena"}[1m]))
```
errors: 0.11 -> 0.025 errors/sec (1m rate) after change. Good sign.
maya (custeng): I'll notify Zelena support and tell them we're applying mitigations. Short message ready: "We're seeing increased latency; applying scheduler changes; minimal interruption expected." Want us to escalate to SOC/AE?
emma (devex): Send the short update to the customer-facing channel, cc eng-runtime. I'll prepare a follow-up note for the support ticket.

sam (oncall-sre): One more quick tweak: disable continuous small-sequence batching for this tenant (batching.mode=adaptive) — this reduces latency variance for mixed seq workloads. Applying next.
kai (eng-runtime): Applied batching.mode=adaptive. Also temporarily lowered tenant concurrency cap from 40 -> 20 to limit burst pressure while we stabilize.

sam (oncall-sre): Monitoring: 10m after initial change -> errors are down to ~0.5% of baseline, p99 reduced but still above SLO for heavy seq tail. Customer-visible errors minimal now. :thumbsup:
ajay (next-oncall): ACK. I'll be on watch for the next handover. Leave any debugging notes in INC-2026-0456.
kai (eng-runtime): Notes for follow-up: (1) need long-term per-tenant seq distribution profiling during onboarding, (2) add auto-suggest for max_batch_tokens based on observed median+95th token lengths, (3) schedule a canary test for new batching knobs.
sam (oncall-sre): For clean handoff: incident currently mitigated (errors <1%), customer notified. Will keep incident open for postmortem and runbook update. Ajay will take 2hr watch, then tag morning shift.

maya (custeng): Zelena support confirmed reduced errors; they're seeing transactions succeed again. They asked for a short RCA once available.

sam (oncall-sre): Next steps:
- ENG-Runtime to open a follow-up RFC for per-tenant batching safeguards (kai)
- Prod SRE to run a regression eval on dedicated-pool-7 with synthetic long-seq workload (sam)
- Customer comms: devex/custeng to prepare RCA draft (emma/maya)

kai (eng-runtime): Will create RFC and include proposed autosuggest heuristics and a safe default cap. I'll also post the exact commands I ran to the incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Last update at 1764502799.
sam (oncall-sre): Handing over to ajay for continuous monitoring. Ajay please ack when you're watching.
ajay (next-oncall): Ack. I'll watch dashboards and promote to full incident if errors >1% for 5m.

sam (oncall-sre): Thanks team. Postmortem tags: #inc-zelena #tenant-batching #scheduler-knobs. Closing slack coordination thread, leaving incident open for follow-up tasks.
